Facility Inventory & Condition Assessmen.justification: Comprehensive district-wide inventory including detailed site maps and extensive condition assessments across all major systems (HVAC, plumbing, roofing, electrical, lighting, technology, accessibility). The plan connects condition data to student outcomes and instructional priorities, identifying immediate and long-term needs integrated into capital planning (Executive Summary, Site Summaries, Cost Estimating Overview).

Enrollment & Capacity Planning.justification: Provides detailed enrollment projections with methodology, site-level capacity utilization data, and explicit strategies for addressing over- and under-capacity including closures, consolidations, boundary changes, and adaptive uses such as wellness hubs and community partnerships (Executive Summary, Site Summaries).

Educational Alignment.justification: Educational alignment is a core organizing principle with clear integration between district mission, instructional priorities, and facilities planning. The plan comprehensively analyzes how facilities support multiple programs (TK, CTE, special education, collaborative learning, technology) and connects projects directly to educational goals (Site Summaries, Additional Needs).

Outdoor Spaces & Greening.justification: Districtwide data on outdoor spaces including square footage of green surfaces, shade coverage, and stormwater management. Detailed strategies for campus greening such as expanding tree cover, permeable surfaces, outdoor classrooms, rain gardens, bioswales, and access to natural spaces are included, framed as climate resilience strategies (Site Summaries, Additional Needs).

Climate Risk & Mitigation.justification: Plan addresses multiple climate impacts and resilience strategies in detail, including air filtration, shade structures, and stormwater management. Climate readiness is a priority and theme throughout the plan, but comprehensive districtwide assessment and multi-impact mitigation strategies are less fully developed than required for top score (Executive Summary, Site Summaries).

Energy Efficiency & Resilience.justification: Energy resilience and efficiency are core parts of the plan with detailed data on energy use, strategies for electrification, renewable integration, and resilience (solar + storage, microgrids). The plan references state requirements (Title 24, Zero Net Energy goals) and includes comprehensive decarbonization and electrification strategies (Executive Summary, Site Summaries).

Financial Plan & Capital Strategy.justification: Presents a comprehensive capital strategy with detailed cost estimates for all projects, clear prioritization criteria (health, equity, program alignment, lifecycle cost, climate resilience), and multiple funding strategies including bonds, state programs, developer fees, and alternative financing. Considers long-term financial sustainability and aligns financial capacity with educational priorities (Executive Summary, Cost Estimating Overview).
